words.gloss: even to those who possess strength
relying on or taking refuge in

literal: Even to those of hostile strength, relying on a fortress, the resulting success will yield many benefits.
translation: Even for those who possess aggressive strength, securing a proper stronghold and acting from it will yield many advantages.
modern: பகைமை கொண்ட வலிமை உடையவர்களுக்கும், ஒரு பாதுகாப்பான அரணைப் பற்றிக்கொண்டு செயல்படுவதால் உண்டாகும் நன்மைகள் பலவற்றைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of choosing a proper place or stronghold, which is the theme of this chapter. Even warriors who possess immense physical strength and hostile power cannot rely on raw force alone. By securing a proper fortress or defensive position, they gain a strategic advantage that multiplies their power. Thus, acting from a secure base yields numerous benefits and ensures victory.
